title: Near-closure of a finance-surviving Juggler word reveals a reusable exact local obstruction
statement: A large exact search for E_L(n,w)=|T_w(n)-n|/n on structurally admissible words at L=25781, n>=10^6+1, produces either an exact cycle, an unusually close almost-cycle with a stable signature, or a family of near-returns whose terminal failure is a common exact local configuration that can be converted into a leftover-killing theorem.
counterexamples: 8.5e6 odds in [2e6+1, 19010076]: 0 survive 25781 AboveAnchor steps; max packed-legal first-passage is 257 at n=6127057
The unique distinguished itinerary (extremal=Christoffel=packed Beatty) has max follow depth 11 and mean depth 2.03; 0 complete followers
All 96 exact backward beams die at an empty OOE preimage after at most 2 of 9515 blocks; MITM fails the same way
mathematical_domain: Juggler cycle finance / exact almost-cycle search
notes: Phase 1 only. No 2^L enumeration. No Phase 2/3. Not a floor certificate for the 7481 high-peak seeds. No Paper A edit, no ledger row, no Lean. Not a halt theorem.
tested_range: Forward CycleMin scan of 8505038 odds in [2000001, 19010076] with bit_cap=16384; follow on [10^6+1, 10^6+20001]; backward beam on 96 endpoints; 64-sample high-peak rewalk; L=19 calibration
